The '''Vonak 21-Dx light laser cannon''' was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The cannons were mounted on the [[SS-39L]] variant of the [[SS-39 Space Skiff]].
